milestones.label: Zelmanov solves restricted Burnside problem for odd exponent
milestones.work: E. I. Zel'manov, Solution of the restricted Burnside problem for groups of odd exponent, Math. USSR Izv. 36 (1991) 41-60
milestones.description: Zelmanov proves finitely many finite quotients of bounded exponent for odd prime-power exponents using Lie-algebra methods.

evidence.claim: Crossref record confirms title, author, journal and year (English translation 1991)

milestones.note: Russian original appeared 1990; the catalogue 1989-1991 range is unverified.

notes: Only the Zelmanov 1991 translation was verified. Hall-Higman 1959 reduction (catalogue 1959) and the even-exponent case were not searched. No first_statement of the problem verified (Magnus 1950 not opened).
